contribution.position: Reliability signals are mixed: the test report shows 412 passed with 0 failures and 87% coverage, and the perf report shows p99 within budget at peak load, but the incident log records two sev2 incidents last quarter traced to retry storms — precisely the failure mode this queue change touches. Before confidence in reliability is warranted, evidence is needed that the change's behavior under retry-storm conditions has been exercised, since neither the test report nor the perf report explicitly addresses that scenario.
